name: Narrator
message: 「...Once again this year, that passionate season is upon us.」

name: Narrator
message: 「A summer festival brought to you with the full might of Murakumo Academy！」

name: Narrator
message: 「Its name―the 'Murakumo Martial Festival'―！」

name: Narrator
message: 「Here at the Murakumo Academy stadium, the air is electric with the excitement of spectators eagerly awaiting the competitors' entrance！」

name: Narrator
message: 「This Martial Festival is a ritual praying for the nation's prosperity and peace, dedicating to the Grand Shrine a sacred blade forged with the utmost skill by a swordsmith bearing the rank of Saishou.」

name: Narrator
message: 「And the one who takes up that sacred blade to offer prayers to the gods on behalf of all the people is the champion who stands at the pinnacle of this Martial Festival—the 'Toujinegi'.」

name: Narrator
message: 「Having fought their way through the fierce preliminary matches, the swordfighters who have stepped forward to claim the title of Toujinegi gather right here today！」

name: Narrator
message: 「Now then, for this year's Martial Festival, we have invited a very special guest.」

name: Narrator
message: 「Currently taking the Jindou Pro League by storm—it's Nakamura Sakura！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Yo! Good to meet ya, everyone!」

name: Narrator
message: 「Nakamura Sakura will be providing commentary during the matches. Sakura-san, thank you very much for joining us！」

name: Nakamura Sakura
message: 「Never done this kinda thing before, so I dunno if I'll be any good at it, but hey, bear with me, alright！」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「Bringing you this Martial Festival will be Sakura-san on commentary, alongside myself as your host—Sassa Naruko, third-year student of the Quartermaster Division.」

name: Sassa Naruko
message: 「And now, the Murakumo Martial Festival is about to begin！！！」
...At last, the first day of the Murakumo Martial Festival main tournament has arrived.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa—whoaaaaaaa！ Look, look, it's Nakamura Sakura！！」
Watching the TV broadcast on a holographic display, Setsugekka is practically bouncing off the walls with excitement.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka... calm down a little.」
This is the backstage entrance where the competing fighters wait. Everyone from Takamura Class had gathered in one corner of it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But, but, Sakura is my idol！？ And she's going to be commentating on my match！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah... I'm so glad to be alive...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehehe, you might end up suffering a crushing defeat right in front of your beloved idol Nakamura Sakura, you know.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Gyaaaaah, anything but thaaaat！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, I'm gonna win！ I'm taking the whole championship！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Not a chance. I'm the one who's going to win.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh yeah, Momi-chan? Still talking big? Wanna settle this right here and now, huuuuh?！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Save it for the stage.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san looks like she's about to go off the rails at any second.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「*Sigh*... Honestly, what a handful.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mmph, come on, everybody! Let's get a little more hyped up!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「*Sigh*... If Ririmu-chan were here, she'd be getting into it with me.」
Everyone had noticed long ago, and deliberately avoided bringing it up.
Ririmu isn't here right now.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Iori-sensei, did you reach out to Ririmu-san？」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course. I told her to stop by if she felt up to it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I see.」
Since Ririmu was eliminated in the preliminaries, she can't participate in the main tournament. Therefore, she has no reason to come here today.
Still, Ririmu is an important member of our Takamura Class too. I don't want to leave her out.
That said, considering how she must feel, I can't bring myself to blame her for not showing up.

name: Momiji
message: 「...It can't be helped. That's just the kind of world we're in.」

name: Momiji
message: 「We're going to compete in the main tournament now. Even so, not all of us can become the Toujinegi.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Some girls win, and some lose along the way. We knew that from the start, didn't we?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know that, of course, but... Ririmu-chan is our friend. If she's feeling down, I want to cheer her up.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That wouldn't be any comfort to her at all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat？！ You're so cold, Momimomi！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...Setsugekka-san, please think about it.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Suppose you were the only one eliminated in the preliminaries」

name: Asahi
message: 「Would having those of us advancing to the main tournament console you really heal that wound？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-No... Probably not, I guess...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Exactly, so there’s nothing we can do for Ririmu right now」

name: Momiji
message: 「What we need to do now is go out there and win. We can think about everything else after the Martial Festival is over」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't you agree, Iori-sensei?」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, it’s painful, but Momiji is right.」
I turn to face a dejected Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, your concern for your friend is noble and wonderful. I hope you always hold onto that.」

name: Iori
message: 「But for now, I need you to focus on the match right in front of you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei……」
I continue, hoping to spur her on.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, the spot you earned in the Martial Festival main tournament is something every single swordsman would kill for.」

name: Iori
message: 「There are so many people who have worked themselves to the bone for three years for this very day, yet couldn't reach it.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why you must give it your all and face it with total sincerity. Don’t you think that’s what you can do right now？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Yeah, you’re right.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once you understand that, pull yourself together, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, sir！！」
Good, Setsugekka’s expression has changed.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright everyone, listen up.」

name: Iori
message: 「……When I first came to this academy, they said the Takamura Class was nothing but a hopeless bunch of troublemakers.」

name: Iori
message: 「But look at you all now! The Takamura Class is the center of everyone’s attention!」
Snakes and ogres that were once thrown into the bamboo grove—they have bloomed into magnificent, large flowers like this.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, Momiji, Asahi, and though she isn't here right now, Ririmu too. You are all incredible swordsmen.」

name: Iori
message: 「As the one who has watched from the sidelines, I believe I know your capabilities better than anyone.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why I have no worries.」

name: Iori
message: 「I will support you with everything I have. I will always be watching your backs.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei…… I’m so happy.」

name: Iori
message: 「All of you are my precious students.」

name: Iori
message: 「Win or lose, no matter the outcome,」

name: Iori
message: 「the way I cherish you all will never, ever change.」

name: Iori
message: 「No matter what anyone else says, I am proud of you all！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Sensei……」

name: Iori
message: 「So you can rest easy, and give it everything you've got！」

name: Iori
message: 「And when the match is over, hold your heads high and come back to me with pride！！」

name: Iori
message: 「That is all！！！」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes!」
A dignified, resolute response, befitting of the Martial Festival, came from them all.
